# scarlet-text



<!-- Auto Generated Below -->


## Overview

Body copy with the design system's text scale, color tokens and
single-line truncation — the general-purpose counterpart to `scarlet-heading`.

## Properties

| Property   | Attribute  | Description                                                    | Type                                                                | Default     |
| ---------- | ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- |
| `align`    | `align`    | Text alignment.                                                | `"center" \| "left" \| "right"`                                     | `'left'`    |
| `as`       | `as`       | HTML tag rendered for the text.                                | `"div" \| "label" \| "p" \| "span"`                                 | `'p'`       |
| `color`    | `color`    | Text color token.                                              | `"disabled" \| "inverse" \| "primary" \| "secondary" \| "tertiary"` | `'primary'` |
| `truncate` | `truncate` | Truncates overflowing text to a single line with an ellipsis.  | `boolean`                                                           | `false`     |
| `variant`  | `variant`  | Visual size, from the design system's body/caption text scale. | `"body-lg" \| "body-md" \| "body-sm" \| "caption"`                  | `'body-md'` |
| `weight`   | `weight`   | Overrides the variant's default font weight.                   | `"bold" \| "medium" \| "normal" \| "semibold" \| undefined`         | `undefined` |
